The '''2009–10 Wake Forest Demon Deacons men's basketball team''' represented [[Wake Forest University]]. The team's head coach was [[Dino Gaudio]]. The team played its home games at [[Lawrence Joel Veterans Memorial Coliseum]] in [[Winston-Salem, North Carolina]], and is a member of the [[Atlantic Coast Conference]]. They finished the season 20–11, 9–7 in ACC play and lost in the first round of the [[2010 ACC men's basketball tournament]]. They received an at–large bid to the [[2010 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament]], earning a 9 seed in the East Region. They defeated 8 seed [[2009–10 Texas Longhorns men's basketball team|Texas]] in overtime in the first round before losing to 1 seed and AP #2 [[2009–10 Kentucky Wildcats men's basketball team|Kentucky]] in the second round.
